Her right hand at screen-left holds complete original astrolabe, her left hand at screen-right holds exactly 3 physical star cards. Do not switch hands. Make only small natural secondary movement in robe/hair/tassels, stable torso/head, never jumping/running.
One front-facing character with fixed bright painted lighting, x512 body axis, y942 grounded foot baseline normalized to1024. Keep whole crown, hair, sleeves, equipment and boots inside generous margins and same scale. No floor/shadow, no colored fringe, no checkerboard, no UI/text, no panels, no particles. Actual independent action, one frame.
